name: Sudatel Data Center Khartoum (SDC)
notes: Official Sudani page describes SDC as Sudan's largest datacenter and a Tier IV facility offering colocation, dedicated servers and VPS. Third-party listings place it on Sinkat Street, Khartoum; DC Hub reports 3.0 MW, so capacity is aggregator-derived.

name: Canar Telecom Sudan Khartoum / Canartel DC
notes: Inflect lists an operational Canar Telecom Sudan data center on Al-Mashtal Street, Khartoum with colocation, connectivity, 11,840 sq ft raised floor and 250 kVA power. Data Center Platform lists Canartel DC at Canar Tower, Al-Mashtal Street. Canar's own site confirms data center management capability but not this facility's specs.

name: Sudan State Data Centre Reopening
notes: Actum Sudan reports, citing Sudan News Agency comments, that Sudan reactivated a 1,300-square-metre state data centre in Khartoum for centralized government systems, cloud computing, data protection and AI-supporting applications. Primary SUNA page was not found in search results, so grade kept weak.

name: SudREN Khartoum Sector Data Centers Project
notes: SudREN's Sectoral Data Centers Project lists a Khartoum Sector for Khartoum State serving public/private universities, colleges, research centers and teaching hospitals; page states the program is in launch phase. No MW disclosed.

name: Soba Hospital Data Center
notes: SudREN lists Soba Hospital Data Center as a national-scope specialized center for connecting and securing data for all teaching hospitals across Sudan; page states the data-center program is in launch phase. Soba is in Khartoum State; no MW disclosed.
